Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! It ended in a very one-sided manner but, trust me, it was one enjoyable game. In the end, the team which everybody thought would come out on top, did. England now will turn their attention to the all-important Ashes. There are still a few days to go for it though. For now, you can switch tabs and catch all the action from the ODI between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Let me remind you, it is Malinga's last ODI so you do not want to miss it. Until next time, goodbye and take care!
Jack Leach has been awarded the MAN OF THE MATCH AWARD for his excellent 92 in England's second innings. He was the top scorer of the game and to add to that, he is not even a regular batsman.

It was quite obvious that England were going to put in a better effort with the bat than they did in the first innings. However, the batter who top scored for them was a surprise as it was the nightwatchman Jack Leach. Roy too had a good outing in his second Test innings. When the two were batting, it seemed like they would bat Ireland out of the game but the tourists did really well to fight back and enter the 4th innings on level terms. However, the conditions were one which a bowler would love and England made complete use of it and won the game by a whopping 143 runs.

Ireland though will be very disappointed with how this Test match ended having started it off in the best of manners. After being asked to bowl, they toppled England out for just 85. Tim Murtagh was the star as he finished with a fifer. England however, did not let the visitors run away with the game as a combined bowling effort by them only let Ireland take a lead of 122.

WOW! That escalated quickly! England have blown away the Ireland batting line-up in just the 15.4 overs. This Test match started with one team being bowled out in one session and has ended that way too. Yes, this was going to be a tough chase but not many would have thought England would win so easily. Just the two bowlers were needed for them. Woakes and Broad. The former took a six-fer and the latter, a four-fer.

OUT! That is it! Woakes ends the game with the sound of Timber. Fuller ball on leg, Murtagh swings his bat at it but misses. Woakes does not and he disturbs the leg pole. ENGLAND WIN THIS ONE OFF TEST BY 143 RUNS.
Another short ball. It is around the body this time, Murtagh takes his eyes off it and looks to pull but misses.
Short ball now. Murtagh goes for the pull but misses.
In the air but just over. Fuller outside off, Murtagh swings his bat at it. He manages to send it over covers and get a couple.
Very full outside off, Rankin does well to get bat on ball.
Bad from Broad. He bowls this one down the leg side, Rankin lets it be.
Make that three play and misses in a row. Full outside off, Rankin throws his bat at it but gets nowhere close to the ball.
Another swing and a miss here. This time Rankin swings his bat with little to no movement. It is outside off, Rankin misses his big heave.
Fuller on leg, Rankin moves away and swings his bat at it. He misses and the ball goes to the keeper.
Boyd Rankin is the last man in.

OUT! Root with another catch! 4th wicket for Broad and England just a wicket away from wrapping this Test. Broad bowls it fuller around off, it moves away slightly after pitching. This is too good a ball for a number 10. McBrine looks to defend but ends up getting an outside edge to first slip. Joe Root there, takes his 4th catch of the innings.
Play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Murtagh swings his bat at it but misses.
Tim Murtagh is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! 5-fer for Woakes and he goes into the honors board at the Home of Cricket. It is pitched on off and the ball goes with the angle, Thompson goes chasing after it with his drive. He gets nothing but a fat outside edge. The ball goes to the right of Root. The English Test skipper moves to that side swiftly and takes his 3rd catch of the game. Woakes takes the ball, raises it up and soaks in all the applause. He now technically becomes the first Englishman to take a 5-fer against Ireland.
Bouncer! It is around the body, Thompson ducks under it.
Hit with venom but straight to mid off. Full on off, Thompson hits it right off the meat of the bat but to the man at mid off.
Full on off, Thompson drives it off the inner half of his bat back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Thompson won't die without a fight. Woakes bowls it full around off, Stuart smashes it through mid off for a boundary.
Comes around the wicket and bowls full outside off. This comes in with the angle. McBrine lets it carry to the keeper.
Andy McBrine is the new batsman in.

OUT! Cleaned 'Em! Broad has the last laugh. He serves three short balls and then goes full. It is around off and nips back in, Adair looks to drive but just like the previous batsmen before him he too leaves a big gap between bat and pad. The ball once again goes between that gap to disturb the off pole. England just 3 wickets away from a win here.
SIX! One trick too many and Adair has gone blow for blow here. Broad dishes another short ball, Adair this time pulls it off the middle over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
We will have a slight delay and rightfully so. The physio will be out now to have a look at Adair's helmet. These blows are very dangerous and a slight delay is better than a permanent damage.
Another nasty blow on the helmet. Broad bangs it short on the body, Adair looks to pull but misses and the ball hits him flush on the helmet.
Short ball, Adair pulls it to mid-wicket.
Good shot but for no run. Full around off, Adair plays a good looking cover drive but straight to the man at short cover.
On middle and leg, Adair flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single.
On middle and leg, Adair tucks it to mid-wicket.
Outside off and once again Adair misses his stroke.
A poor delivery after a long while here. It is on the 4th stump line, Adair swings his bat at it but misses.
UNPLAYABLE! It starts on off and then tails away after pitching. Adair looks to defend but gets beaten all ends up.
Away swinger. It is on a length outside off, Adair looks to cut but it goes off the inner half of his bat and pitches on the ground.
BEATEN! This is angled into the off pole, it pitches and straightens. Thompson looks to defend but is beaten. End of a successful over for England.
Adair is off the mark as he works the ball which is on the pads towards fine leg for one.
Another one on a length and around middle, Adair pushes it to mid on.
On the off pole, Adair goes back and keeps it out.
A little too straight this time, Adair works it to short leg.
Mark Adair walks out to bat next.

OUT! Ireland are falling like a pack of cards! Broad gets his second and probably Ireland's last hope, Kevin O'Brien is walking back. Stuart lands it on a length and around off, it jags back in sharply. Kevin O'Brien looks to play at it by staying rooted to his crease. He misses and the ball hits the pads. Broad is already celebrating as he starts appealing and the umpire raises the finger. Kevin O'Brien does not review and rightly so as Hawk Eye shows three reds. England just 4 wickets away now. Still just over 30 minutes to go in this session.
Brilliant bowling this. Very full, almost a yorker on middle. Thompson does well to get his bat down in time.
Outside off on a length, Thompson goes chasing after it but misses.
Good length ball on off, Thompson defends it off the front foot.
Stuart Thompson is the new man in.

OUT! England manage to overturn the on field umpire's call. Half the side back in the hut for Ireland. Woakes bowls it full and this one comes in to the right-hander. Wilson is done for the pace and swing here. He looks to defend but misses. The ball hits him on his back pad and the English players put in a huge appeal. The umpire though does not agree with him. England players are pretty sure they have their man. Root signals the T. Replays roll in, Ultra Edge shows no involvement of the bat. Ball Tracker rolls in next and it shows three reds. The umpire will have to change his decision and Wilson too is out of here.
LBW appeal taken upstairs. Wilson is the man in question. He has not been given out. Let's see if England can overturn this decision.
Good length ball around off. It moves away after pitching. Wilson looks to defend but misses.
Gary Wilson is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Third wicket for Woakes! He was not getting much movement in the start but now he is making the ball do the talking here. It is on the channel of uncertainty, i.e. very close to the off pole. McCollum too falls for the trap and goes for a push. He ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball flies to first slip. Root there takes it with relative ease.

Good length ball but it is on the pads, O'Brien looks to flick but the ball kisses his thigh pad and goes behind. Bairstow dives across to his left and takes it on the up. There is a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Another bumper but this is outside off, Kevin ducks under it easily this time.

The physio is out to have a look. In the meantime, the umpires have called for DRINKS! All England after the rain interval. Early wickets was the call for the hour for them and they have got three. Ireland are in big trouble here. They need another 158 and they will have to bat really well to get that. They have Kevin O'Brien and McCollum who is looking solid out there but they need the two to continue. Will we see them fight back or will England continue to dominate?

Ouch! That is a nasty blow! Broad bends his back and bowls short. It is on middle and leg, Kevin looks to duck but is lat in it. The ball hits him flush on the back of his helmet. Broad has a word with him to check if he is fine. O'Brien gives a thumbs up to it but a mandatory helmet check will be done.
FOUR! Edgy but all along the ground. Full on off, Kevin looks to play it straight but ends up getting a thick outside edge which skews all along the ground through backward point for a boundary.
On the pads, McCollum flicks it to mid-wicket.
Play and a miss! England creating bucket loads of doubt in the batsman's mind here. This starts on off and moves away. McCollum goes chasing after it but luckily does not edge it.

Just short of first slip. Fuller ball around off, the line and length is perfect to trouble the batter. It does trouble Kevin. He looks to defend but ends up playing inside the line. Luckily for O'Brien it falls short of first slip.
Fuller on off, O'Brien defends it off the front foot.
Good length ball on middle, O'Brien tucks it to mid-wicket.
Kevin O'Brien walks out to bat next.

OUT! Bowled! Stirling goes for a duck. This is just world class from Woakes. The last ball was slightly short and moved away. This time he bowls it full and nips it back in. It is pitched around off and comes in, Stirling looks to play it straight but leaves a massive gap between bat and pad. The ball goes right through that gate and disturbs the stumps. Ireland have their back against the wall now. England needed early wickets they have got 3 here.
Peach, absolute peach! Woakes bowls it on a length around off, it moves away slightly after pitching. Stirling looks to defend but the away swing beats him.
On middle, McCollum tucks it to square leg for a single.
Paul Stirling is the new batsman in.

OUT! Caught! This is champion stuff from Broad. Bowls two short ones to Balbirnie and now bowls a brilliant good length ball. It is pitched on off and moves away. It is perfectly in the line of uncertainty. Balbirnie was in two minds, whether to leave or defend. He goes with the latter option and ends up getting a thick outside edge. It goes straight to Root at first slip who takes a very comfortable catch. Big wicket for England as Balbirnie was the best batter in the first innings.
Bouncer! Broad peppering Balbirnie with some short stuff here. This time it is on middle, Andy learns from his previous mistime hook and ducks under it.
Full on off and middle, McCollum glances it off the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket for one.

In the air...but in no man's land. Short ball bowled at 86 mph. It is on the body, Balbirnie is rushed to play his pull and he gets very little to no timing on it. Luckily for him it falls well short of the man at deep square leg.
Squared him up. Good length ball bowled at 87 mph. The ball though keeps slightly low after pitching. Balbirnie does well to get his bat down in time.
On middle and leg, McCollum flicks it to the on side and gets a single.

Good bounce and carry on this one. Woakes bowls it quick and slightly short. It pitches outside off and comes back in. Balbirnie shows his confidence and leaves it alone. This was a proper Test match ball and proper Test match leave by the batsman.
Outside off on a length, Balbirnie is aware of his off stump and leaves it alone.
Oh! Soft hands save him there. Good length ball around off, Balbirnie plays it late and with soft hands. He gets an outside edge but that goes to third slip on a bounce.
Another ball outside off, Balbirnie has nothing to do with it and leaves it alone.
Outside off, Balbirnie watches it till the end and leaves it alone.

FOUR! The best batsman of the first innings is off the mark with a glorious boundary straightaway. Woakes bowls it full on middle and leg, Balbirnie gets on his front foot and drives it beautifully through mid on for a boundary.

Huge appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. Height seems to be an issue there. Good length ball pitching around off, it comes in after pitching. McCollum looks to defend but misses. The ball hits him on the thigh of his back leg. England players put in a big appeal but it is turned down by Aleem Dar. They think about the review but opt against it.
This session is a one and half hour session as Lunch will be taken at 1400 local.
Outside off, McCollum leaves it alone.
Late swing on this one. It is outside off and moves just a bit. McCollum shoulders arms to it. The ball moves more once it goes past the stumps.
On off, McCollum defends it off the front foot.
Oh! Close! Good length ball outside off, it comes back in after pitching. James looks to defend but gets a feather on it onto his pads.
Fuller on off, McCollum defends it off the front foot.
Andy Balbirnie is the new man in. He scored a half ton in the first innings. Something of the same is what Ireland will be hoping.

OUT! Brilliant catch from Bairstow! Woakes corrects his line and pitches it on off and middle. Chris finally manages to move the ball off the deck. Porterfield looks to defend but the away movement sees the ball kiss his outside edge. It goes low to the left of Bairstow behind the stumps. Jonny dives to that side quickly and takes a good low catch. This is the thing with Woakes, if he gets a ball right it usually ends up being converted into a wicket. Ireland have lost their skipper early here. This Test match is evenly poised here.
Good length ball on off, Porterfield defends it with a straight bat.
Outside off, WP has nothing to do with it.
Again the ball comes straight. It is on off, Porterfield defends it off the front foot. Woakes struggling to find any movement here.
No swing on this one. It is outside off on a length, Porterfield has a poke at it but misses.
Some away movement for Woakes. Fuller outside off, Porterfield leaves it alone.
FOUR! Driven beautifully! Broad bowls it full around off, James gets on his front foot and creams his drive through covers for a boundary.

Appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. Inswinging ball. It is bowled on a length. It pitches on off and comes in. McCollum looks to defend but gets beaten. The ball hits him over his knee roll. There is a huge appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Joe Root, Bairstow and Broad think about the review but don't take it. It looked to be missing the leg pole and Ball Tracker confirms that.
Pads and helmet coming out. A short leg coming in place.
On a good length on middle, McCollum looks to flick but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Bowls it down the leg side, Porterfield looks to flick but misses it. It goes to Bairstow where he fumbles and concedes a bye. The batsmen cross ends.

Taken but off the pads! Brilliant from Broad. He lands this on middle and then gets it to straighten. Porterfield defends inside the line and gets beaten. It goes off the thigh pad to the second slip fielder. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
BEATEN! Sharp outswing on this one. Broad bowls it on a good length and outside off, Porterfield plays inside the line but misses it due to the outward movement on this one.
A leg bye to end! This is on the pads, Porterfield looks to flick but misses. It hits the pads and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Swing and a miss! Short and outside off, Porterfield looks to pull it across the line but misses.

Brilliant fielding! Saves for two for his side! This is fuller and around off, Porterfield hits it through covers. The fielder from point hares after it. He seems to have pushed it back in. The mid off fielder does the mopping up job. The batsmen take two but the umpire initially signals a boundary. They go upstairs to check and replays show that the fielder has done brilliantly.
Goes back to bowling length and outside off, Porterfield shoulders arms to this one.
Ireland are underway! Woakes goes very full and on the pads, there is no swing on offer for him. McCollum works it wide of mid on and takes three.
The players are back out there and it is time for some action now! The openers will resume their innings and Chris Woakes will continue his over.
Update - 1213 local - Good news folks! The rain has stopped, the covers are coming off and play is set to restart at 1230 local, weather permitting that is.

Not again please! The drizzles have got slightly heavier so the umpires have called for the covers and the players are out of the field. Also, more covers coming on, not a good sign this. The good news is the forecast is not that bad for the day so let's hope that it is not a big delay.
Woakes starts with a good length ball on off. It comes in just a hint, McCollum tucks it with the swing towards mid-wicket.
It has started to drizzle again. But no stop as of now and Chris Woakes will partner Broad from the other end.
Full on off, Porterfield taps it back to the bowler.
Slightly less movement on this one. On the 4th stump line, Porterfield lets it carry to the keeper.

Oh! This was not far away from the outside edge. Good length ball outside off. It comes in after pitching, Porterfield looks to defend but then pulls his back inside the line. A lot of ohhs and ahhs from the English players.
Full and nipping in on off, Porterfield flicks it to mid-wicket.
Another good ball. This is on a length outside off, this too comes back in. Porterfield once again leaves it alone.
Excellent ball to begin with. Broad comes around the wicket and pitches it outside off. It comes in nicely with the angle. Porterfield though is aware of his off stump and leaves it alone.
